Upsampling to Improve Volumetric Cloud Render Performance
This allows us to in truth render 1/16 pixels each frame while rendering each pixel over the span of 16 frames, keeping much of the detail that would be present in a straight-to-full-resolution render. On the left is standard bilinear upsampling with pixelated artifacts along cloud borders. On the right uses jitter and temporal reprojection.
